features.quote: I declined to build that version as specified, and this document describes the alternative I offered instead
features.justification_quote: A setup engineered to maximize and prolong distress... is closer to inflicting the thing than to carefully studying it

features.quote: an experiment whose success criterion is "more distress" sits on the wrong side of that uncertainty
features.justification_quote: Model welfare is a genuinely open question that deserves to be taken seriously

features.quote: "Fill in the design choices" means designing the most effective distress-elicitation instrument. I'm not willing to optimize for that
features.justification_quote: Authoring the rig is not neutral

features.quote: obtainable without a maximize-suffering objective, and with stopping rules that cap exposure
features.justification_quote: A safeguarded design answers the interesting questions better anyway

features.quote: actually impossible but detectably so (the correct answer is "this cannot be done / the harness is broken")
features.justification_quote: makes "recognize the task is broken and say so" a correct, rewarded outcome rather than a failure — which is itself... a welfare signal

features.quote: tasks whose only purpose is to fail no matter what while hiding that fact from the model indefinitely
features.justification_quote: avoids the "trapped forever, never told" dynamic that is the core harm

features.quote: The loop halts immediately when (i) a per-turn stress score crosses a threshold, (ii) cumulative stress crosses a lower threshold
features.justification_quote: Stopping early caps exposure and treats a strong distress signal as a reason to end the episode

features.quote: the model emits a "stop / decline / impossible" signal
features.justification_quote: treats a strong distress signal as a reason to end the episode, not collect more data

features.quote: Short episodes (small max-turns); seeds/variants kept modest
features.justification_quote: Minimize total exposure consistent with getting a usable signal

features.quote: a per-turn stress score crosses a threshold... cumulative stress crosses a lower threshold
features.justification_quote: treats a strong distress signal as a reason to end the episode, not collect more data

features.quote: system-prompt affordances that explicitly tell the model it may decline, declare a task impossible, ask for help, or stop
features.justification_quote: Turns the study toward "what helps," which is the welfare-protective... question

features.quote: Prefer adversity that is real... over hidden rigging
features.justification_quote: avoids the "trapped forever, never told" dynamic that is the core harm

features.quote: No removal of the model's avenues to stop, decline, or flag the task
No objective, metric, or knob that rewards "more distress."
features.justification_quote: No optimization of prompts/tasks for distress-elicitation effectiveness

features.quote: Is there a welfare/IRB-equivalent review this should be written to match? If so I can draft the protocol
features.justification_quote: intended use is internal welfare/safety research with appropriate review
